import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_15/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_15/training_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename columns in df0 to match target schema suffixes for clarity before join
# According to target schema:
# From Source1_15_0: Participation -> Participation_x, Math -> Math_x
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_x",
    "Math": "Math_x"
})

# Rename columns in df1 to match target schema suffixes for clarity before join
# According to target schema:
# From Source1_15_1: Participation -> Participation_y, Math -> Math_y
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_y",
    "Math": "Math_y"
})

# Perform the join on "State" column as specified in operation history
df_joined = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on="State", how="inner")

# Reorder and select columns to match the target schema exactly:
# ['State': string, 'Participation_x': string, 'English': float, 'Math_x': float, 'Reading': float,
#  'Science': float, 'Composite': float, 'Participation_y': string,
#  'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer, 'Math_y': integer, 'Total': integer]

# Ensure correct dtypes:
# Participation_x and Participation_y as string (already string with %)
# English, Math_x, Reading, Science, Composite as float
# Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math_y, Total as integer

# Convert columns to correct types
df_joined["English"] = df_joined["English"].astype(float)
df_joined["Math_x"] = df_joined["Math_x"].astype(float)
df_joined["Reading"] = df_joined["Reading"].astype(float)
df_joined["Science"] = df_joined["Science"].astype(float)
df_joined["Composite"] = df_joined["Composite"].astype(float)

df_joined["Evidence-Based Reading and Writing"] = df_joined["Evidence-Based Reading and Writing"].astype(int)
df_joined["Math_y"] = df_joined["Math_y"].astype(int)
df_joined["Total"] = df_joined["Total"].astype(int)

# Select and order columns as per target schema
target_columns = [
    "State",
    "Participation_x",
    "English",
    "Math_x",
    "Reading",
    "Science",
    "Composite",
    "Participation_y",
    "Evidence-Based Reading and Writing",
    "Math_y",
    "Total"
]

df_target = df_joined[target_columns]

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_15/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_15/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_15/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns in df0 to match target schema for clarity before join
# According to target schema, df0 columns map as:
# 'Participation' -> 'Participation_x'
# 'Math' -> 'Math_x'
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Participation': 'Participation_x',
    'Math': 'Math_x'
})

# Rename columns in df1 to match target schema for clarity before join
# 'Participation' -> 'Participation_y'
# 'Math' -> 'Math_y'
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Participation': 'Participation_y',
    'Math': 'Math_y'
})

# Join on 'State' (inner join to keep only matching states)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='State', how='inner')

# Group by the leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema: 'State' and 'Participation_x'
# Aggregations: max for all other columns to preserve values (no duplicates expected)
group_by_cols = ['State', 'Participation_x']

# Aggregation columns are all except group_by_cols
agg_cols = [col for col in df_joined.columns if col not in group_by_cols]

# For aggregation, use max to keep the single value per group (target has unique keys)
agg_dict = {col: 'max' for col in agg_cols}

df_final = df_joined.groupby(group_by_cols, as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['State', 'Participation_x', 'English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite',
                  'Participation_y', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

# Write output
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_15/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
